contracts.Column: Optional top [u,v] is absolute at y1; optional lean [du,dv] offsets the base point at y0. Mutually exclusive. Existing vertical behavior is preserved when neither is supplied. steelWhite is a kit material; concrete remains supported.
contracts.Canopy: finish glassRoof builds glazed roof panels and a primary/secondary steelWhite frame; clear/frosted glass and frame colour are configurable. sideGlass is a vertical height extending down from the canopy underside y and its panels have colliders. Canopy creates no supports; supports remain separate Column elements.
contracts.Balustrade: Use the existing Balustrade with panel solid and collider true for an opaque closed boundary. Repeat the first polyline point to close the loop. No separate Fence type was added, per request.
contracts.Ground: Slab and FloorFinish accept lawn, sand, paving, and asphalt ambientCG CC0 PBR finishes; source and license receipts are recorded separately.

sceneChanges: None by KitExtend8; Main owns scene build/save. The preview canopy supports are separate test Columns, not generated by Canopy.
checkSpec: Not run on request fixtures: these are isolated contract cases, not station placement specs.
